findings.description: delete_entry guards with _require_reader, which admits any user in entry.readers. A user who was shared an entry can therefore call delete_entry and permanently remove it through store.remove, destroying the owner's data for all readers. Only the owner should be able to delete. The owner-only helper _require_owner exists and is used by edit_entry, share_entry and unshare_entry, so this is an authorisation inconsistency.
findings.suggestion: Replace _require_reader(entry, user) with _require_owner(entry, user) in delete_entry, so that only the owner can delete. Readers who want to stop seeing the entry should use leave_entry.
findings.title: Any reader can delete the owner's journal entry
